gap: No result ChatGPT got gives today's prices: the Garmin vívoactive 6 is $249.99 at Abt with a $50 Garmin rebate that ends 2026-12-28, the Fitbit Charge 6 is $159.95 at Target (ChatGPT's card said $123.99), Amazfit's Active 2 Round and Helio Strap are $99.99, and Apple's US store lists the Apple Watch Series 12 from $399 but not the Series 11 that ChatGPT showed for $379.
standout_why: I could not read the two cited pages. WebFetch can't reach wired.com or menshealth.com, and curl needs approval in this environment. So I can't say exactly what WIRED (2026-06-19) and Men's Health (2026-06-16) list. Both are dated five months before today, though, so they can't hold the rebate that ends 2026-12-28, today's Target price for the Charge 6, or the Series 12 that Apple's store now shows. ChatGPT's own cards ($123.99 Charge 6, $379 Series 11, no WHOOP price) also differ from what the stores show today.
decides: This backs ChatGPT's choice of the vívoactive 6 as the overall pick: it costs $249.99 until 2026-12-28, which is $149 below the $399 Series 12 and $70 below its own $299.99 list price. It weakens the Charge 6 as the 'best value': at $159.95 it costs $60 more than the Amazfit Active 2 Round ($99.99, up to 10 days battery) or the Helio Strap ($99.99, no subscription). It also means the Apple card shows an older model than the one Apple sells today.
